test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

Let this letter be posted at once.

options.text: He will post this letter at once.
This letter needs to be posted at once.
This letter will be posted at once.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Post this letter at once**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given above sentence is in a 'passive voice form', hence we need to convert it into an 'active voice form'.
 
• We need to follow these instructions while changing the voice of an imperative sentence.
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of **an Imperative sentence**.
 
• The imperative sentence in **active voice **always **starts with the main verb of the sentence**.
 
• Remove the word '**Let**' and '**be**' because **these words are not used in the active form of the Imperative sentence**.
 
• in an imperative sentence(**passive voice**) **3rd form of the verb** is used. The 3rd form of the verb is changed into **1st form of the verb** for **making **the **active voice of the imperative sentence**.
 
 
 
• Let's have a look at the structural form of the given rule:
 
 
• ​**Let + subject + be + V3. (passive voice)**
 
• **Main verb(V1) + subject. (active voice)**
 
 
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the imperative sentences.
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Let the food be cooked. (passive voice)*
 
• *Cook the food. (active voice)**​*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that ‘Post this letter at once’ is the correct active form of the given sentence.
